output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    if len(pts)<2: return out
    # find ordered arithmetic line from the given points; use row ordering
    pts.sort()
    dr=pts[1][0]-pts[0][0]; dc=pts[1][1]-pts[0][1]
    if dr==0 and dc==0: return out
    # require all points lie on this progression
    if any((r-pts[0][0])*dc != (c-pts[0][1])*dr for r,c in pts): return out
    # direction as established by row/coordinate ordering
    r,c=pts[-1]
    while True:
        r+=dr; c+=dc
        if not (0<=r<len(out) and 0<=c<len(out[0])): break
        if out[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=2
    return out"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    ans=[r[:] for r in grid]
    ones=[(r,c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c]==1]
    if len(ones)<3: return ans
    ones.sort()
    # infer the repeated displacement from the first and last supplied marks
    dr=(ones[-1][0]-ones[0][0])//(len(ones)-1)
    dc=(ones[-1][1]-ones[0][1])//(len(ones)-1)
    r,c=ones[-1]
    while 0<=r+dr<len(grid) and 0<=c+dc<len(grid[0]):
        r+=dr; c+=dc
        if ans[r][c]==0: ans[r][c]=2
    return ans"}
